name: A moving image collection
art: Use the actual curated asset list in site/js/expansion/editorial.js as evidence of image variety. Create or curate equivalent original imagery; budget image decoding and use responsive sizes.

properties.label: Protected type amid image collection
properties.text: Place large readable type in a protected central zone while a curated collection of image cards occupies the surrounding field with varied size, rotation, depth order and generous intervals.

properties.label: Dominant editorial reading anchor
properties.text: Keep the central type stronger than every individual image card and protect the heading, action and header throughout the composition.

properties.label: Neutral shell with image-led color
properties.text: Use warm near-white and graphite for the interface while richly rendered objects and illustrations carry the collection's color.

properties.label: Varied curated image cards
properties.text: Give every card distinct material or imagery and establish an authored sequence of subject, crop, scale and overlap rather than scattering arbitrary rectangles.

properties.label: Thin layered image cards
properties.text: Use crisp card edges, subtle thickness, small shadows and controlled overlaps to establish front-to-back order.

properties.label: Bounded slow image drift
properties.text: Animate image transforms slowly inside a tested envelope while type and actions remain fixed; reduced motion holds an intentional authored arrangement.

properties.label: Pausable kinetic collection
properties.text: Provide a pause action and recompose the collection for portrait screens without losing the central reading zone.

properties.label: Full-travel collision acceptance
properties.text: Sample multiple timestamps and every travel extreme for collisions with the heading, actions and header, and compare the actual art quality rather than only the number of cards.
